utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, have you heard? We're having a repair drive this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center—I'm bringing my toaster, and Jules is helping gather the gardening club for tools!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great, Vik! I'll be there to help out—bring your toaster and I'll take a look at it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Awesome, Sam! So it's this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. Can't wait to fix that toaster with your help!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Rey, I'm glad we're teaming up—should make quick work of those repairs. I'll grab the extra shelving from my garage too, just in case we need it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good thinking, Gus. I'll make sure my tool kit has everything ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, I'll swing by your place Saturday morning so we can load up together.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Noah, you'll be glad to know we've got more than enough for that fence—turns out plenty of folks had smaller things needing fixing too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's good to hear, Cleo. Now, I'll need the exact times and a list of those smaller items so I can slot them into our repair schedule properly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing, Eli—I'm sorting at my garage at 10 tomorrow morning, and I've got the list right here. I can send it over or read it off to you now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Faye, sorry I'm a bit lost — what repair drive are you talking about?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Noah, it's the big one we're planning for Saturday! We have a list of odd jobs from all over the neighborhood — willing to lend a hand with supplies? I really need someone to help drive them over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the big one. Yeah, I can drive supplies. Just tell me where and when.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Alright, Leo said to bring my tools for a power issue—just the wrench and screwdrivers, no diagnostic gear.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: A power issue? I've got an old blender that's been acting up—maybe someone could take a look at it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure, Uli, but I'll need to check what's wrong with it first—power issues can vary. Does it not turn on, or is it something else?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, you're just the person I wanted to see! Vik's organizing that repair drive this Saturday—think you could bring along your toolbox and maybe help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, yeah, I heard about it from Quinn. I'll bring my toolbox for sure—just remind me when and where, and I'll try my best not to be late this time!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, Dane! We're meeting at the community center at 9 a.m.—and don't worry, I'll swing by your place with coffee to make sure you're on time!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I heard something about that while I was at the grocery store. What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is this repair drive about? I'm not joining anything unless I know the specifics.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It's a community thing where we fix up broken stuff around the neighborhood—fences, faucets, even small electronics. Jules is organizing it, and I think it's happening this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just worried we might not have enough extension cords for people working in different spots. Should we make a list of what everyone's bringing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That's a smart idea, Pia. I can help you draft a list if we sort it by the garage and the community center separately.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that would be wonderful, Opal. Let's make sure we include extension cords, power strips, and a backup plan just in case.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, Nell—are you sure that old drive is gonna work? I don't want to end up with a fried router.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh gosh, I really hope so! I don't know much about the technical side—I just heard it's supposed to help fix stuff. Maybe Eli knows more?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you don't even know if it works? I'm not letting you near my router until we talk to someone who actually knows what they're doing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? Gus is bringing his toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh yeah, Gus told me. I think Rosa's helping wrangle everyone—hopefully it all comes together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Rosa's involved? That's wonderful—she's so good at keeping things organized.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Leo! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're gathering at the community center from 10 to 4—bring any broken items you'd like to fix!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I heard. I'll be there at 9 to help set up. Bring your tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's great, Leo! I'll make sure to have my toolbox ready. See you at 9!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Mara! Tomorrow evening at the Elm Street garage it is—I'll bring some refreshments while we sort through the volunteer list together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds perfect, Rosa! I'll bring my clipboard and a highlighter to help organize the shifts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Mara! A highlighter and clipboard—you're thinking ahead. I'll grab some of those sticky notes too, just in case we need to reshuffle.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Nell, I'm glad I caught you! We're organizing a repair drive this Saturday and could really use your help with transporting supplies.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a repair drive this Saturday? I'd love to help! I can borrow my cousin's truck to move supplies — where do I pick things up?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great! The supplies are at the community center loading dock. Can you swing by around 8am to load up?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just a heads-up, Pia—the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center. We could use your help coordinating if you're available!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Sunday works fine for me. Do we have enough extension cords and power strips for the community center outlets?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Good question, Pia! I'll check our supply list and see what we have. Can you help me round up any extras from neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually using that old drive? Are you sure it's safe?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, absolutely—I've already got a broken toaster and an old blender set aside for the repair drive at the community center. It's this Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, Saturday at 9. But I still want to know – what makes you so sure that drive won't fry my router?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might be able to help with that, Vik. I've got a steady hand for small repairs.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's great, Uli! I'm planning to set up the repair drive for this Saturday, so if you can bring your steady hand and any small tools, that'd be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure thing, Vik. I'll bring my small screwdriver set and maybe that old lamp I've been meaning to look at.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane! Yeah, I'm helping out with the repair drive this Saturday. Need me to look at anything for you?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, thanks for offering! I'm still catching up—what all are you fixing there? I might have a broken toaster that could use some love.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Toasters I can handle, Dane! Bring it by—I’ll have it working like new in no time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Leo! I was just going to ask if you had any spare tools we could use for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got a box of spares in my garage. Meet me at 8:30, we'll sort through them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Leo—I'll be there at 8:30 sharp. Bring your coffee too, we might be at this a while.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm still a bit fuzzy on the details, Mina. Is the repair drive at the old garage on Elm Street or the community center?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So you're not sure either? I need to know if there's someone actually coordinating this thing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think Cleo mentioned working at the garage, not the community center—maybe that's where the actual repairs happen.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Rey! The repair drive... I think I mentioned my old toaster? Or was that for something else entirely?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the toaster! I can take a look at it during the repair drive if you'd like.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That's kind of you, Rey—though I can't remember if I already brought it last time or if it's still sitting in my garage.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Jules, heard about the repair drive? I've got my toolbox ready if anyone needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's awesome, Gus! I was just talking to Ira about it—maybe we can get a little team together to tackle some of those bigger projects.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I like that idea—count me in for any heavy lifting or tool lending you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, a repair drive? I thought we were just fixing one fence — did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, it's a whole neighborhood repair drive! We're fixing up several things around the community—fences, porches, even some small appliances. You should come by Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wow, that's a lot more than I expected. I guess I should show up and help out, then—just point me at whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hello Quinn, I'm organizing the repair drive. Do you know what items people plan to bring? I like to have a clear list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, hey Eli! So far, Dane mentioned a broken lamp, and Uli has an old toaster—I think Opal might bring some garden tools too!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that's a solid start. I'll add them to the list — lamp, toaster, garden tools. Any idea on the times they're dropping by?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Bo, did Leo mention what specific issue we're fixing? I want to make sure I bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, you know Leo—he just said 'the usual stuff.' I think it's mostly lawnmowers and that old fridge of his, but don't quote me on that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hmm, that doesn't sound like a power issue then. I'll bring the basics, but I'll also pack my multimeter just in case.
